left.heading: LEFT: forward soil-optics nose points SCREEN LEFT, broad near flank is visible
left.tanks: Tall ribbed tank SCREEN LEFT and shorter round tank SCREEN RIGHT, exactly as FIRST reference top-left body. Keep the single large visible aft side bearing boss on the SCREEN RIGHT edge. The forward mounting plane under the optical nose is genuinely occluded: do not invent a second exposed hip pin. The visible side grille and two-aperture soil optic remain on the same side as the first reference.
left.workref: SECOND ROW of the SECOND reference is the matching left-facing work context.

right.heading: RIGHT: forward soil-optics nose points SCREEN RIGHT, broad near flank is visible
right.tanks: Tall ribbed tank SCREEN RIGHT and shorter round tank SCREEN LEFT, exactly as FIRST reference top-left body. Preserve the large aft lower side boss on SCREEN LEFT and the smaller original forward boss near the sensor base on SCREEN RIGHT; original small aft upper boss may remain. Do not invent exposed pins on the hidden far side. The side grille and two-aperture soil optic stay on their original physical side.
right.workref: THIRD ROW of the SECOND reference is the matching right-facing work context.

back.heading: BACK: facing AWAY toward SCREEN TOP, rear shell and central REAR LOUVERED VENT visible
back.tanks: Tall ribbed tank SCREEN RIGHT and shorter round tank SCREEN LEFT, exactly as FIRST reference top-left body. Preserve the original two visible large side bearing bosses. NO forward optical face on the rear. Keep the rear cooling grille intact and closed through all poses; it is not the planting nozzle.
back.workref: TOP ROW of the SECOND reference is rear-work context, but that older raw row has a horizontal tank inconsistency. The FIRST reference canonical BACK body wins: tall tank SCREEN RIGHT, short tank SCREEN LEFT. Do not copy the FRONT optical face or front tank asymmetry from the THIRD reference.
